t: This is New Hall, a banqueting hall in the London Borough of Camden. It was designed by Philip Hardwick, an English architect particularly associated with railway stations and warehouses. He is best known for the Euston Arch, which has been demolished, and for the original Birmingham Curzon Street station, the oldest railway terminus building in the world. I don't have more detail about the hall itself, but it is worth knowing the name behind it.
